provenance: Primary file matched immutable GitHub blob and SHA256. Immutable diff from the prior review changes only upgrade.rs.

findings.concrete_case: Custom XDG unit A must not authorize stop of another installation B resolved by the user's manager.
resolution: Read the manager's actual absolute FragmentPath, DropInPaths and NeedDaemonReload.

Read that real fragment with the existing O_NOFOLLOW, owner, regular-file, bound, marker and root checks; require exact content equality to the validated installation definition, including its single expected ExecStart.

Reject missing/other loaded configuration, any drop-in, pending reload, active service without a verifiable MainPID, or an active process whose /proc/PID/exe inode differs from the expected recovery image.
Revalidate before the first stop, on successful candidate health, and before rollback stop; do not rely solely on the invoking process's XDG_CONFIG_HOME.
findings.remaining_execution_gate: Independent private-manager fixture should prove foreign fragment/root and foreign active PID rejection before any stop/start action. This review did not execute it.

confirmed_preserved: Separate private backup is retained after both success and rollback; only owned staging file is removed.
Target identity and backup digest checks remain before activation/restore; replacement is atomic rename with fsync.
Success requires changed MainPID, fresh matching state.pid/observed_at, connected registration and candidate executable identity.
Shared install.lock serializes mutations while upgrade does not hold the service lifetime run.lock.
No saved-session definitions, snapshots, units, Config.client/cwd/server or recovery unit definition are rewritten by upgrade.
Failure report distinguishes binary restoration, restart and confirmed connected state.
validation_limits: Source review only; no Cargo or tests run by this reviewer.
No upgrade command, real systemd manager, online 007 configuration, credentials or existing session mutated.
The latest planned acceptance uses a private manager substitute with real 007/session processes and gateway observations; it does not install or control any real unit.
